newsitem.title: USA: Playboy TV venture expanding to Spain, Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Playboy TV venture expanding to Spain, Portugal.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc and The Cisneros Television Group said Wednesday they plan to launch the Playboy TV and AdulTVision networks in Spain and Portugal.
Cisneros Television is part of the Cisneros Group of Cos.
The company said this new project is an expansion of the two companies' joint venture, Playboy TV Latin America LLC.
The networks are expected to be launched in the second quarter of calendar 1997.

Cisneros, which owns and operates television stations throughout Latin America and is a leading producer of television programming, holds an 81 percent interest in the new venture. Playboy holds the remaining 19 percent with an option to increase ownership to 49 percent.
Playboy also receives license fees for its programming and royalty fees for the use of the Playboy brand name for pay television.

"With more than 15 million television households, Spain and Portugal now join the countries of Latin America, the U.K. and Japan as major international territories with Playboy TV networks," Christie Hefner, chairman of Playboy, said in a statement.
